ai_mark_restore: Accessibility description of a trash button on an AI row in the effects list; it undoes that AI change and brings back the original file.
ai_noise_mixed: Option of Reduce Noise: the sound is music or a mix of sounds, not just speech.
ai_noise_wind: Option of Reduce Noise: the sound has wind or low rumble in it.
animation_in: Tab of the Animate sheet: animations that bring the layer in at its start (an intro), not the preposition.
animation_loop: Tab of the Animate sheet: animations that repeat for the whole clip.
animation_out: Tab of the Animate sheet: animations that take the layer out at its end (an outro), not the preposition.
animation_title: Title of the sheet with In, Out and Loop animations for a layer.
audio_fx_voice_filter: Name of an audio effect that holds sliders for pitch, bass, treble and more; voice filters are presets of it.
audio_param_amount: Slider of the High Pitch and Low Pitch audio effects: how far the pitch moves, in semitones.
audio_param_fullness: Slider of the Voice Filter audio effect: how full, strong and even the voice sounds (compression).
audio_param_muffle: Slider of the Voice Filter audio effect: dulls the high frequencies so the sound is muffled, as if heard through a wall.
audio_param_thin: Slider of the Voice Filter audio effect: removes low frequencies so the voice sounds thin, like on a small speaker.
auto_captions: Subtitles made automatically from speech (like auto captions in CapCut).
caption_layer_name: Default name of a subtitle text layer made by Auto Captions, followed by its number.
effects_category_audio: Category in the effects list that holds the sound effects for audio clips.
export_audio_summary: Summary row of audio export settings: codec, bit rate, sample rate, mono or stereo. Keep the dots and units.
export_checked_problems: After the export the file was played back to check it; %1$s is the list of problems found.
export_heat_critical: Phone temperature status in the export info rows: very hot, so exports pause.
export_heat_hot: Phone temperature status in the export info rows: hot, so exports go slower.
export_list_and: Joins two names in a list, for example container formats: "WebM and MKV".
export_list_or: Joins two names in a list of choices, for example codecs: "VP9 or AV1".
export_space_low: Storage status after the free space value: little space left.
export_use: Button that switches to suggested export settings; %1$s lists them, like "H.265 · 720p".
export_what_is: Accessibility label of a (?) help button next to a setting name.
fx:datamosh:name: Datamosh is a proper name of a glitch technique: keep it exactly as "Datamosh" in Latin letters in every language.
fx:repeat:name: Name of an effect that draws repeated copies of the layer (a noun, like "Repeater"), not the verb or a button.
fxcat:repeat: Effect category for effects that draw repeated copies of a layer (a noun for the group, like "Repetition"), not the verb.
fxpreset:countupdown:count-up: One-tap text animation: a number counts up from zero.
fxpreset:textprogress:fade-in-by-word: One-tap text animation: the words fade in one after another.
fxpreset:textprogress:pop-in: One-tap text animation: letters pop into place (scale up quickly).
fxpreset:textprogress:slide-up-by-letter: One-tap text animation: the letters slide up into place one after another.
fxpreset:textprogress:typewriter: One-tap text animation: letters appear one by one like a typewriter.
fxpreset:textrandomizer:scramble: One-tap text animation: random letters keep changing and settle into the real text.
fxpreset:texttransform:spin-cascade: One-tap text animation: letters spin into place one after another.
fxpreset:texttransform:wave: One-tap text animation: letters move up and down like a wave on water.
history_add_named: Name of an edit shown in the undo toast: adding a layer; %1$s is the layer's name, shown between quotation marks.
history_delete_named: Name of an edit shown in the undo toast: deleting a layer; %1$s is the layer's name, shown between quotation marks.
history_mask: Name of an edit shown in the undo toast: turning a clipping mask on or off.
history_media: Name of an edit shown in the undo toast: swapping a layer's picture, video or sound file for another.
history_position: Name of an edit shown in the undo toast: moving a layer on the canvas (a verb or action name).
history_redid: Short toast shown after the user presses Redo; %1$s is the short name of the change that was redone. Past tense: 'Redid'.
history_rotation: Name of an edit shown in the undo toast: rotating a layer (a verb).
history_size: Name of an edit shown in the undo toast: changing the size of a layer.
history_timing: Name of an edit shown in the undo toast: trimming or moving a clip in time.
history_undid: Short toast shown after the user presses Undo; %1$s is the short name of the change that was undone (e.g. Move, Opacity). Past tense: 'Undid'.
layer_tool_voice_filters: Button on an audio clip that opens ready-made voice filters (presets for changing how a voice sounds).
motion_blur: Animation that brings a layer in or out with a blur.
motion_bounce: Animation where the layer drops in and bounces.
motion_fade: Animation where the layer fades in or out (opacity).
motion_float: Looping animation where the layer gently drifts up and down, as if floating; not the number type.
motion_pop: Animation where the layer pops in or out by scaling quickly, like a bubble; not music.
motion_pulse: Looping animation where the layer grows and shrinks a little, like a heartbeat.
motion_rotate: Looping animation where the layer keeps turning round.
motion_slide_down: Animation where the layer slides in or out downwards.
motion_slide_left: Animation where the layer slides in or out to the left.
motion_slide_right: Animation where the layer slides in or out to the right.
motion_slide_up: Animation where the layer slides in or out upwards.
motion_spin: Animation where the layer spins round as it comes in or goes out.
motion_wobble: Looping animation where the layer rocks from side to side.
motion_zoom_in: Animation that zooms the layer in.
motion_zoom_out: Animation that zooms the layer out.
preview_fast_blur: Short two-line toggle on the preview: motion blur drawn quickly (approximate). Keep the line break.
preview_full_blur: Short two-line toggle on the preview: full quality motion blur. Keep the line break.
settings_emoji: Settings label: which emoji pictures text layers use when the user types emoji.
settings_emoji_android: Emoji style option: the standard Android (Google Noto) emoji built into the app. Keep the brand name Android.
settings_emoji_system: Emoji style option: the emoji that come with the phone (its operating system).
shape_name_record: Name of a shape that looks like a vinyl record (a flat disc with a hole), not the verb "to record".
tilt_x_rotation: Caption in capitals under a value: rotation around the X axis (3D tilt).
tilt_y_rotation: Caption in capitals under a value: rotation around the Y axis (3D tilt).
transition_cross_dissolve: Video transition between two clips: the first fades into the second.
transition_dip_black: Video transition: fade to black, then to the next clip.
transition_dip_white: Video transition: fade to white, then to the next clip.
transition_flash: Video transition: a bright white flash at the cut.
transition_glitch: Video transition: a digital glitch (broken, shifted picture) at the cut; use the word video apps use, often the loanword.
transition_push_down: Video transition: the next clip pushes the first one down out of the frame.
transition_push_left: Video transition: the next clip pushes the first one out to the left.
transition_push_right: Video transition: the next clip pushes the first one out to the right.
transition_push_up: Video transition: the next clip pushes the first one up out of the frame.
transition_shake: Video transition: the picture shakes at the cut.
transition_title: A transition between two video clips (noun).
transition_whip_pan: Video transition: a very fast camera pan with motion blur between the clips (whip pan / swish pan).
voice_cheap_mic: Voice filter that imitates a low-quality, tinny microphone.
voice_deep: Voice filter that makes a voice low and deep.
voice_echoey: Voice filter that makes a voice sound as if in a large empty space, with echoes.
voice_ethereal: Voice filter that makes a voice sound airy, dreamy and otherworldly.
voice_full: Voice filter that makes a voice sound fuller and stronger.
voice_helium: Voice filter that makes a voice high and squeaky, like after breathing helium.
